correctness.rationale: The vector Poisson-reset process exactly projects to the BES(3) reset semigroup; its unique invariant series has characteristic product with two-factor R3-integrable bound, proving a positive continuous density and cubic radius law. The strong-contraction constant follows from s=ct and domination by (1+s²)^-1. The weak-contraction constant follows from exact coordinate-variance normalization, log-product Gaussian convergence, and an integrable uniform fourth-power Fourier envelope. The generator-second-moment identity is an independent exact cross-check. The included program passed 21 numerical consistency assertions; numeric checks are corroborative only.

Fixed-c stationary density existence/smoothness from Grzywny et al. and conditioned radial identification from Kolb-Wübker are acknowledged as prior results, not renamed novelties. value.rationale: The small-radius coefficient of the invariant law is the precise boundary-occupation statistic relevant to the positivity-conditioned resetting model. Its two singular parameter laws have different exponents and exact constants, prove existence of an interior maximum, and replace a qualitatively false super-polynomial assertion in a directly motivating paper. The contribution is the complete two-ended parameter classification of this natural coefficient, not a cheap variance check or a relabeling of the known stationary density.
